_comment: Captured shape of mcp.canva.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource as of 2026-04-30. Paired with the SKILL.md empirical-verification timestamp. If the consent screen scope-count, permission labels, or OAuth metadata fields drift, an outsider can compare a fresh fetch against this snapshot to localise the change without needing a live test harness.

consent_screen_observed.permission_labels_truncated: designs:read, designs:write, assets:read, assets:write, folders:read, folders:write, comments:read, comments:write, exports:read, AI design generation, brand templates:read, brand templates:autofill, brand kits:read, help:read, editing transactions

drift_check_recipe.step_1: From any shell with curl: curl -s https://mcp.canva.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource | jq '.'
drift_check_recipe.step_2: Compare the live response's scopes_supported array against the array above. Any new entry probably means a new tool category landed on the MCP. Any removed entry is the change you should care about because it may indicate a tool has been retired and a SKILL Tool Reference row needs updating.
drift_check_recipe.step_3: If the scopes_supported list is byte-identical to this snapshot, no SKILL changes needed. If different, open an issue and update the SKILL.md Phase 2 Tool Reference to match before re-running Phase 1.
drift_check_recipe.out_of_band_signal: If Canva ships a new consent screen design (different permission labels or count), the install transcript at examples/canva-export-designs-session.md will be the first place a non-technical user notices because the narration line in Step 4a names the count explicitly. Update both the SKILL and the example together.

_why_no_automated_script: An automated drift-check script would belong in tests/ and the canva-connector's parent workshop kit reserves tests/ for the existing kit-wide smoke and verification harness. Drift checking on a third-party SaaS is also rate-limit-aware work; it should run from a human or a scheduled job, not from every PR's CI run. The snapshot here is the durable artifact; the script is left as a one-line curl in the drift_check_recipe above.
